visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette; the lower jaw is rendered as a smooth, thickened curve to represent the dense filter-bristles as a single mass.
visual_logic.environment: Soft sunset gradient (Peach to Deep Orange) with subtle 'God-rays' filtering from the top-right corner.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: Warm rim-light highlights the elegant upward curve of the beak and the soft 'fuzz' (pycnofibers) along the neck.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: The primary identifier is the distinct 'up-curved' beak and the thickened lower jaw that looks like a specialized comb.

pose: Side profile in a wading stance; one leg is slightly lifted to emphasize a graceful, flamingo-like movement. The wings are folded neatly against the body to keep the focus on the unique head shape.
negative_constraints: No individual needle-lines for teeth; avoid sharp, jagged edges; no low-angle 'villain' lighting.
